decisions.reason: As a 2023-launched burner component tied to the firm's core radiant-heating business, it is still an inexpensive option to keep open, but the weaker website prominence suggests a somewhat higher chance of pruning if demand stays thin.

Its own product page indicates a real commercial launch, and for a German heating-equipment maker the cost of leaving a new electric panel heater in the portfolio for another year is likely lower than the value of learning about market uptake.

The dedicated page shows initial commitment, but an electric halogen infrared heater looks a bit more peripheral and easier to abandon if traction disappoints, so it carries a higher drop risk while still being worth one more year of observation.

An industrial electric infrared hall heater fits the firm's industrial heating competence and electrification trend well, so the option value of keeping it on the market remains high relative to the likely carrying cost.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared heater has clear strategic upside and had already entered real operation in 2023, so despite uncertainty management would likely preserve this option rather than exit early.
